title: 법무자문위원회규정 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2 (Composition)
(1) The Committee shall consist of not more than 25 members, including one Chairperson, taking gender into consideration: Provided, That where a special subcommittee is established under Article 4 (2), the Committee may have up to 155 members. <Amended on September 4, 1975; August 31, 1985; December 14, 1989; November 9, 2004; August 6, 2007; and February 3, 2022.>
(2) The Chairperson shall be designated by the Minister of Justice from among the members. <Amended on August 6, 2007.>
(3) Members shall be appointed or commissioned by the Minister of Justice from among persons with extensive specialized knowledge and experience relating to legal affairs, and their term of office shall not exceed two years: Provided, That the term of office of members of a special subcommittee under Article 4 (2) shall not exceed one year. <Amended on September 4, 1975; August 31, 1985; and February 3, 2022.>
